PLAN "12-Week General Strength - Post L4-L5 Herniation (No Heavy Spinal Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "General strength and durability"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper - Push Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower - Hip Hinge Low Load":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 60 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body - Stability":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
